cass-culverts.geojson.caveats: Culverts: Cass County (sublayer of the Culvert Inventory group layer 12, which is not queryable). OWNERSHIP here is an ownership class, not a person. The McKinley Twp culvert sublayer (14) was not in the approved scope. FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
